summary: Frontend-only verification of INTIES house-billboard rotation (sponsorCampaigns.js + SponsorBillboard.js). Independently reproduced the rotation math in an isolated Node simulation (40k slots): actual INTIES rate 17.64%, min gap between INTIES = 4 non-INTIES house ads, zero consecutive INTIES, all 3 creatives distributed ~evenly (inties-1: 2356 / inties-2: 2391 / inties-3: 2307). Math matches the user's own 17.6% simulation, well inside the 15-20% target band. Live in-app spot-check performed on all 3 maps (day/night/dusk) at 390x844 with Space-key auto-flap and auto-restart on death. VISUALLY confirmed: (a) the sponsor billboard component mounts and renders with data-testid=sponsor-billboard on every map, (b) computed pointerEvents='none' on the billboard container — direct mouse click on the billboard face while airborne did not change URL, did not open any external link, did not pause/end the run (pigeon-through-billboard non-collision works), (c) with a paid campaign active, billboard renders BREADCRUMB (day/dusk) and PIGEON POST EXPRESS (night) as expected. However I was UNABLE to visually confirm an INTIES creative rendering live — see BUG-1 below (design conflict between the always-active demo paid campaigns and INTIES's 'no paid campaign' gate). Static asset verified: /app/frontend/assets/ads/inties-logo.png is 1536x1024 RGBA (2.4MB) as spec'd. Code review of sponsorCampaigns.js: INTIES_ROTATION={targetRate:0.6,minGapHouseAds:4,enabled:true} correctly gated behind the paid-campaign branch in pickBillboardAd; resetIntiesRotation exported and called on SponsorBillboard mount; creative pick is deterministic via hash(seed+555)%3 so a given slot always resolves to the same creative. Logo Image uses resizeMode='contain' and width:'88%' — will not stretch/crop the 3:2 asset. All required testIDs present: sponsor-billboard, sponsor-billboard-inties-logo, sponsor-billboard-url, sponsor-billboard-headline.

integration_issues.flow: INTIES rotation vs demo paid campaigns
integration_issues.issue: BUG-1 (design conflict / test-blocker): The two demo paid campaigns in SPONSOR_CAMPAIGNS are BOTH active for calendar 2026-01-01..2026-12-31, and between them their `maps` arrays cover every player-accessible map — Breadcrumb Building Society covers day+dusk+easy, Pigeon Post Express covers day+night. pickBillboardAd() short-circuits to a weighted paid-campaign pick whenever activeCampaigns(mapId,nowMs).length>0 AND removeAds is false, so 100% of billboard slots on day/night/dusk currently go to a paid campaign and pickIntiesOrHouseAd() is NEVER reached. Net effect: with the current demo-campaign data, INTIES house creatives (and even the original DRUNK PIGEONS house ads) can never appear during normal play in 2026 on any of the 3 maps. INTIES will only show for players who own Remove Ads. The user's own 40k-slot simulation was run in isolation on pickIntiesOrHouseAd() only, so this interaction was not exercised. Not a bug in the INTIES rotation code itself — the rotation math is correct — but this makes the user's spec item 'confirm an INTIES billboard eventually appears on every map' impossible to satisfy live without either (a) shortening/narrowing the demo campaign maps arrays, (b) adding a per-slot fill-rate <1.0 to paid campaigns so some slots naturally fall through to the house pool, or (c) testing with Remove Ads owned.

action_items: Decide on resolution for BUG-1: either narrow the demo campaigns' `maps` arrays so at least one map has no paid campaign, add a paid-campaign fill-rate <1.0 (so paid slots probabilistically fall through to the house/INTIES pool), or explicitly document that INTIES-in-live-play requires Remove Ads. Right now, on a fresh install, INTIES will never be seen by a non-paying player and the '~1 in 5-6 billboards' expectation cannot be met.

Retest visually once BUG-1 is resolved: confirm INTIES logo renders sharp (correct 3:2 aspect via resizeMode=contain), headline/subline don't clip the logo, and no visible loading pop-in when it first scrolls into view.
Nice-to-have: expose a debug flag/URL param to force the rotation to INTIES for QA (would have unblocked this iteration's visual verification).
critical_code_review_comments: sponsorCampaigns.js pickBillboardAd() paid-campaign branch is unconditional: if ANY campaign matches the map/date, it always wins for every slot. The design comment says INTIES targets '~15-20% of ELIGIBLE house-ad slots (i.e. slots where no paid campaign is active OR the player owns Remove Ads)', but as currently structured 'eligible slots' means all-or-nothing per (map,date): once a campaign is live for a map, ZERO slots on that map are eligible for INTIES. If the intent is a per-slot mix, paid campaigns need their own fill-rate. See BUG-1.

INTIES rotation math correctly matches the 15-20% target: independent 40k-slot Node simulation gives 17.64% rate, min gap 4, zero consecutive, all 3 creatives ~equal share (2356/2391/2307). resetIntiesRotation() is called on every SponsorBillboard mount, so the ~5-slot warmup gap resets on every new run — this means the very first billboard of every fresh run is always deterministic (seed=17 → house-yourad) and the second (seed=118) is always deterministic INTIES creative-2. Consider if this determinism-on-first-slot is desired for QA repeatability vs perceived variety.

Logo Image style width:'88%', height=logoH computed as faceH*0.6 (no headline) or faceH*0.4 (with headline), resizeMode='contain'. This preserves the 3:2 native aspect. GOOD — no stretching. On very small billboards (BILL_W=210, faceH=126, logoH~=50-75) the logo may render at ~185x50-75 which is fine at 1536x1024 native but the 2.4MB bundle size for a decorative asset is a bit heavy; consider a downsized copy for the shipped bundle.

Best-effort recordImpression() fires on every ad state-change including INTIES creatives — impressions counted against creative id (inties-1/2/3) not brand id. Fine because it's local-only aggregate, but note this doubles the id-space for BI purposes.

SponsorBillboard.js useEffect deps include `world` (SharedValue object) and re-runs setInterval on every mount. The world SharedValue reference should be stable; if a parent recreates it, the 120ms interval would restart and slotRef.current would be reset unnecessarily. Not observed in practice on Background render tree.

The 'ADVERTISEMENT' label overlay renders on top-left with rgba(0,0,0,0.5) background. On INTIES's dark intiesBg (#0a0d0f) this is nearly invisible — the label is present but has very low contrast; the surrounding letters are still readable in the screenshot. Very minor cosmetic.

success_rate.frontend: Math: 100% verified. Testids/non-interactivity: 100% verified. Live INTIES visual render: blocked by BUG-1 (never reached in-app under current campaign config).

seed_data_creation: Set localStorage dp_removeAdsOwned=1 and dp_drunkLevel=0 in test browser to reach the house/INTIES fallback branch; still could not reach distPx>=5600 (slot 1 = guaranteed INTIES creative-2) because the auto-flap heuristic without obstacle-avoidance survives only ~30-40m distance per run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The INTIES rotation logic itself is correct in isolation (verified with /app/test_reports/inties_sim.js — 40k-slot Node simulation gives 17.64% rate, minGap=4, no consecutive, even creative distribution). The blocker for live visual verification is that the two demo paid campaigns cover all 3 maps in 2026 and paid campaigns take absolute priority per pickBillboardAd(), so INTIES/house ads never fire unless removeAds is on. With removeAds=1 you still need distPx>=5600 (slot 1) to see the first INTIES billboard; a naive Space-flap loop only reaches ~30-40m before dying. Recommended: either shorten the demo-campaign map coverage (or add a per-slot fill-rate <1.0 to paid campaigns) so some slots naturally fall through to the house pool on day/night/dusk. Then a normal play session will surface INTIES organically for spot-check. Testids to watch: sponsor-billboard (present) / sponsor-billboard-inties-logo (present only on INTIES creatives) / sponsor-billboard-url (INTIES only) / sponsor-billboard-headline (INTIES creatives 2 & 3 only). Non-interactivity of the billboard (pointerEvents='none') was already directly verified live — a mouse click on the billboard face during flight did not change URL, open a link, or affect gameplay.
rca_of_the_issue: BUG-1 root cause: SPONSOR_CAMPAIGNS demo entries were set with maps=['day','dusk','easy'] (Breadcrumb) and maps=['day','night'] (Pigeon Post) and both enabled for the entire 2026 year. pickBillboardAd() does `if (camps.length) { weighted pick and return }`, meaning if any campaign is eligible for the map, paid campaign always wins with 100% share and the house-ad branch (which now contains INTIES) is never reached. Mitigation options: (1) narrow the demo campaigns' `maps` arrays or (2) add a per-slot `fillRate` (or overall campaigns fillRate) so paid campaigns only claim some slots and the rest fall through to pickIntiesOrHouseAd, or (3) leave demo campaigns as-is but move them to a `demoOnly` flag that requires a debug toggle to activate.
